science_relevance.scientific_problem: Infer regional methane emissions from atmospheric satellite observations and transport modeling.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Quantifying emissions identifies discrepancies in inventories and supports understanding and mitigation of methane's climate effects.

papers.title: Quantifying methane emissions from the largest oil-producing basin in the United States from space
papers.primary_goal: Estimate methane emissions from oil and gas production in the Permian Basin using TROPOMI observations and atmospheric inverse modeling.
papers.task_relation: The local task defines the same observation-to-emission inversion family through a curated IMI case and transport operator. The required case remains unstaged; scientific relevance does not establish implementation readiness, reproducing the Permian estimate or correctness of an unprepared adapter.

science_relevance.reason: The primary study estimates real emissions. The IMI software/facility introduction is not used as the qualifying evidence.
science_relevance.verification_basis: Primary publisher, author, or PubMed/PMC paper abstract and relevant task description inspected on the web; local catalog contract inspected. No independent reproduction of the paper is claimed.
